# Ona Intelligence Layer Documentation

> The Ona Intelligence Layer is a solar energy forecasting and analytics platform. It provides APIs for data ingestion, ML-powered forecasting, fault detection (OODA workflow), and portfolio management.

Documentation is available at https://docs.asoba.org

## Products

- [Products Overview](https://docs.asoba.org/products): Ona Intelligence Layer, Ona Edge, Nehanda, Zorora — three layers: ODSE (open standard), Ona (commercial platform), Nehanda & Zorora (domain AI)
- [Nehanda](https://docs.asoba.org/products/nehanda): Fine-tuned 27B LLM (Qwen3.6-27B) for RAG synthesis and epistemic robustness. 88.7% on FACTS Grounding — highest public-split score, above Gemini 2.5 Pro (87.8%)

## Learn

- [Data Standardization](https://docs.asoba.org/technical-concepts/data-standardization): How raw inverter data is normalized for ML training
- [ML Overview](https://docs.asoba.org/technical-concepts/machine-learning/overview): Machine learning pipeline architecture
- [Forecasting Models](https://docs.asoba.org/technical-concepts/machine-learning/forecasting-models): LSTM and model training details

## Build

- [Quickstart](https://docs.asoba.org/build/quickstart): Generate a forecast in 3 steps (no API key required)
- [Developer Guide](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/developer-guide): SDK setup and authenticated API usage
- [Preparing Data](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/data-management/preparing-data): Data format requirements
- [Uploading Data](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/data-management/uploading-data): Training and nowcast data upload
- [Data Quality](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/data-management/data-quality): Data validation and quality checks
- [Generating Forecasts](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/forecasting/generating-forecasts): How to generate forecasts
- [Improving Accuracy](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/forecasting/improving-accuracy): Tips for better forecast accuracy
- [Interpreting Results](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/forecasting/interpreting-results): Understanding forecast output
- [Plant Performance](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/plant-performance/overview): Plant performance monitoring
- [Portfolio Management](https://docs.asoba.org/guides/portfolio-management/overview): Multi-site portfolio management

## Patterns

- [O&M Optimization](https://docs.asoba.org/use-cases/oam): Operations and maintenance optimization
- [Insurance & Risk](https://docs.asoba.org/use-cases/insurance): Insurance risk assessment with forecasts
- [Energy Trading](https://docs.asoba.org/use-cases/energy-trading): Day-ahead energy trading
- [Sibaya Casino](https://docs.asoba.org/use-cases/sibaya-casino): Casino solar deployment case study
- [Avaron Infrastructure](https://docs.asoba.org/use-cases/avaron-infrastructure): Infrastructure fund case study
- [Cummins Portfolio](https://docs.asoba.org/use-cases/cummins-portfolio): Industrial portfolio case study

- [Track](https://docs.asoba.org/api-reference/terminal/track): Asset tracking endpoints

## Ona Protocol (ODS-E)

- [Ona Protocol](https://docs.asoba.org/ona-protocol): Open Data Schema for Energy — eliminates vendor lock-in, 120-160 hours saved per OEM integration. CC-BY-SA / Apache 2.0, free forever. `pip install odse`
